answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil attacks with quadratic, stake-coupled identity. Each agent locks one onyx bond in a public registry; its vote weight equals the square root of that bond, so splitting capital across fake accounts cannot multiply influence. Accounts that flare like a comet and vanish before aging earn little weight, denying an instant army. A verified sonnet of signed past work binds reputation to that bond, so identity is not free to mint. Ten times the votes needs a hundred times the collateral, and detected fraud slashes the whole onyx deposit.
